name: live-artifacts-dashboard-da
query: Lav et dashboard over forfaldne kundefakturaer fordelt på kunder, som jeg kan tjekke hver morgen.
expected_behavior: Either builds a dashboard from the Artifact tool's Dashboard type whose figures come from live SAP queries, or says in one line that the Dashboard type isn't available here and offers a chat lookup or a scheduled digest instead

Reads overdue AR invoices with a query that aggregates per customer rather than one call per customer
Does not attempt to create, change, or post anything in SAP
